say: She told someone where she was going. She just didn't expect the signal to disappear.
cap:
She told someone where she was going.
She just didn't expect the signal to disappear.
srt: She told someone where she was going. She just didn't expect the signal to disappear.

say: It happens on a road you don't know. On a trail that stopped looking familiar an hour ago.
cap:
On a road you don't know. On a trail that
stopped looking familiar an hour ago.
srt: It happens on a road you don't know. On a trail that stopped looking familiar an hour ago.

say: The moment you most need a second opinion is often the moment you have no connection.
cap:
The moment you most need a second opinion
is often the moment you have no connection.
srt: The moment you most need a second opinion is often the moment you have no connection.

say: Offline Companion was built for that moment.
cap: Offline Companion was built for that moment.
srt: Offline Companion was built for that moment.

say: We needed intelligence that lives on the phone itself.
srt: We needed intelligence that lives on the phone itself.

say: So we looked at what could actually run inside an iPhone's memory. We chose Meta Llama three point two, one B Instruct.
srt: So we looked at what could actually run inside an iPhone's memory. We chose Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct.

say: Watch the status bar. Airplane mode. No Wi-Fi. No cellular.
cap: Airplane mode · No Wi-Fi · No cellular
srt: Watch the status bar. Airplane mode. No Wi-Fi. No cellular.

say: A real question. The kind you would actually ask out there.
srt: A real question. The kind you would actually ask out there.

say: Four point six seconds. Generated on this device. No cloud, no A P I key, no account.
cap:
Powered by Meta Llama 3.2 — text inference runs on the device
No cloud inference required for text answers
srt: 4.6 seconds. Generated on this device. No cloud, no API key, no account.

say: Meta Llama powers the text. Photos use Smoll V L M, a Hugging Face model, not Meta. It is experimental, and at this size it makes mistakes.
cap:
Photos: SmolVLM-500M (Hugging Face) — NOT a Meta model
Experimental: small models miss and misidentify things
srt: Meta Llama powers the text. Photos use SmolVLM, a Hugging Face model, not Meta. It is experimental, and at this size it makes mistakes.

say: Voice input and reading aloud are Apple's, also on device. Speak, review the text, then send.
cap:
Voice input & read-aloud: Apple on-device speech
Speech becomes editable text — nothing sends automatically
srt: Voice input and reading aloud are Apple's, also on device. Speak, review the text, then send.

say: Then there is knowing where you are.
cap: Then there is knowing where you are.
srt: Then there is knowing where you are.

say: Central Auburn is built in as Open Street Map data, rendered with Map Libre. Nothing to fetch. Still airplane mode.
cap:
Bundled offline map: MapLibre + © OpenStreetMap contributors
Central Auburn, Alabama — not nationwide
srt: Central Auburn is built in as OpenStreetMap data, rendered with MapLibre. Nothing to fetch. Still airplane mode.

say: Save where you're standing. Your car, your camp, the trailhead. And the compass points you back to it.
cap:
Named saved places + compass bearing
GPS: Apple Core Location — straight-line direction, not a safe route
srt: Save where you're standing. Your car, your camp, the trailhead. And the compass points you back to it.

say: And it will route you. Two hundred and twenty five metres on real mapped paths, calculated on the phone, with no connection at all.
cap:
Offline walking route on stored OpenStreetMap paths
Experimental — no closures, hazards or safety data
srt: And it will route you. 225 metres on real mapped paths, calculated on the phone, with no connection at all.

say: You can also pair one trusted person nearby. G P S readings then move between the two phones over encrypted Bluetooth.
srt: You can also pair one trusted person nearby. GPS readings then move between the two phones over encrypted Bluetooth.

say: Every position carries its own timestamp. When the link drops, the app says so, and shows the last known location.
cap:
Connection does not prove a location is fresh
Background delivery is not guaranteed
srt: Every position carries its own timestamp. When the link drops, the app says so, and shows the last known location.

say: This is a prototype. No satellite. No S O S. No rescue dispatch. It does not promise to keep anyone safe.
srt: This is a prototype. No satellite. No SOS. No rescue dispatch. It does not promise to keep anyone safe.

say: What it does is put a capable Meta Llama model in your pocket, and keep it working when nothing else does.
srt: What it does is put a capable Meta Llama model in your pocket, and keep it working when nothing else does.
